doc: Language-neutral conformance vectors for the limen.store capability, version 2 (LCP-075). Each vector runs on a fresh origin. A tab is one registration of the pack (one provider, one connection per database) on that origin; tabs share the origin's databases. Every step's result, and every fact a tab receives, must equal the expectation exactly; {"$any": "bool"|"int"|"string"} matches any value of that kind. A runner that cannot perform a vector's requirement reports it unsupported, never passed. See README.md.

requirements.holdOpen: Open a raw connection to a database (the tab's namespace) that ignores version changes, and close it on release.
requirements.inject:quota: Make the tab's next transaction fail at commit, with QuotaExceededError, after its operations ran.
requirements.inject:openFails: Make the tab's next indexedDB.open fail with the named error.
requirements.inject:storageCleared: Clear the origin's IndexedDB under the tab's open connections, as clearing site data or eviction does: the browser closes them abnormally and the data is gone.
requirements.inject:missing: Run the tab with no indexedDB at all.
requirements.storage:present: The tab's browser has navigator.storage persist, persisted and estimate.
requirements.storage:absent: The tab's browser has no navigator.storage.

vectors.name: a new database is created at the declared version; a reopen reports it was not created
an upgrade adds a store; opening an older version is VersionConflict with the stored version
at the stored version a different schema is SchemaMismatch, naming each difference

problems: store users is stored but not declared
index todos.byDue is stored but not declared

vectors.name: an upgrade cannot change a keyPath in place: SchemaMismatch, and the version stays

problems: store todos keyPath is id, declared uuid; drop it to change it

vectors.name: a connection that ignores version changes makes an upgrade Blocked; the abandoned upgrade never applies
another tab's upgrade: this tab steps aside, hears VersionChanged under the engine's name, and is then NotOpen
another tab's deleteDatabase reaches this tab as VersionChanged with newVersion 0
a transaction commits every operation in order with typed results
LCP-051: an abort at operation n leaves operations 0..n-1 unapplied
a unique index violation aborts as constraint
an operation on a store the database does not have aborts as unknownStore
LCP-058: two tabs compare-and-put the same record from the same read: exactly one commits, the other aborts as conflict with the winner's value
putIf with expected null inserts only if absent; the second insert conflicts and both roll back
LCP-052: malformed requests are InvalidRequest before anything runs: a write in a readonly transaction, a bad key, a bad limit, an empty name

expect.problem: operation 0 writes in a readonly transaction
operation 0 writes in a readonly transaction

vectors.name: close answers Closed, then NotOpen; a transaction on a database this tab never opened is NotOpen
deleteDatabase answers DatabaseDeleted, and the next open creates it again, empty
a request the engine cancelled before it ran answers Cancelled, and nothing is applied
LCP-047: a compound key is the tuple; records sort element by element; a prefix range holds one group
LCP-047: a duplicate tuple in a compound unique index aborts as constraint; a record missing part of its key aborts as invalidKey
LCP-047: a change from a single to a compound key path is SchemaMismatch

problems: store entries keyPath is ns, declared [ns,seq]

vectors.name: LCP-054: count agrees with a query of the same range; deleteRange removes the range, or the whole store
LCP-054: deleteRange inside an aborted transaction removes nothing
LCP-048: two applications on one origin each open 'db'; neither sees the other's writes, and one's delete leaves the other intact

expect.problem: a database name may not contain "/" (the namespace separator)

vectors.name: LCP-050: a value at limit-1 and at the limit commits; at limit+1 it is InvalidRequest; an over-limit transaction is InvalidRequest; nothing over a limit is applied

expect.problem: operation 0 value is 65 bytes, over the limit of 64
the transaction is 304 bytes, over the limit of 200

vectors.name: LCP-050: a transaction the browser fails for quota is Aborted quota with no operation index, and nothing is applied
an open the browser fails for another reason is Unavailable with the exception name
LCP-062: storage cleared under an open connection: ConnectionLost, NotOpen, and a reopen that finds the database newly created
LCP-061/063: with storage APIs present, persist, persisted and estimate answer the browser's values
LCP-061/063: with no storage API, persist, persisted and estimate are Unsupported, never a refusal
LCP-064: availability is Available when a probe database opens and closes in the namespace
LCP-064: with no indexedDB, availability is Missing and an open is Unavailable
LCP-064: a SecurityError is Refused and any other failure is Broken, with the exception name only
